decisions.reason: Because this close-to-core earmold was only briefly mentioned in 2023 and disappeared by 2024, the market signal already looks sufficiently negative to close the option and reallocate resources.
Although it had its own launch page in 2023, its complete disappearance in 2024 suggests weak revealed value, so continuing to carry it is not justified versus other development options.
Its dedicated presence across both 2023 and 2024 indicates ongoing traction in the firm’s core system offering, so the option still appears valuable and worth supporting.

This product is more distant from the core business, but after only one year on the market the uncertainty has not yet fully resolved and the firm’s digital manufacturing capabilities make it reasonable to keep the option open a bit longer.

As a 2024 launch close to the established portfolio and likely complementary to the firm’s digital workflows, it is still too early to abandon while the cost of keeping the option open is probably modest.
